# FreeSportsPicks.pro
# https://www.freesportspicks.pro
# Last updated: June 2026

## About
FreeSportsPicks.pro is a free sports picks and predictions website providing expert handicapper analysis for NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college football, college basketball, soccer, golf, MMA, horse racing, and tennis. All picks are 100% free with no subscription, no signup, and no credit card required. Updated daily by professional sports handicappers.

## What We Offer
- Free NFL picks, predictions, and ATS analysis every week
- Free NBA picks nightly covering spreads, totals, and moneylines
- Free MLB picks daily covering moneylines, run lines, and totals
- Free NHL picks covering puck lines and totals
- Free college football picks every Saturday
- Free college basketball picks daily
- Free parlay picks combining best bets across all sports
- Free prop bet picks for NFL and NBA
- Free MMA and UFC fight card picks
- Free golf picks for PGA Tour tournaments
- Free soccer picks for MLS, EPL, and Champions League
- Free tennis picks for ATP and WTA events
- Free horse racing picks for major race cards
- Game of the Day feature with daily expert pick highlighted on homepage

## How Our Picks Work
Our expert handicappers analyze every game using injury reports, line movement, sharp money tracking, weather data, historical trends, and advanced analytics including KenPom for college basketball and Statcast for MLB. We release picks daily by 10 AM Eastern Time.
